result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 generic tasks/update dispatch adds only the Tasks capability gate before delegating to ServerHandler::update_task; on Ok(()) it maps to ServerResult::task_ack. The bundled TaskDemo directly delegates to TaskManager::update_task. For a known retained terminal TaskManager entry, completion has cleared pending_inputs, so arbitrary tasks/update keys are ignored and the method still returns Ok(()) (touching last_updated_at), producing a wire TaskAckResult; only an unknown/evicted taskId is rejected. Therefore tasks/update acknowledgement is not proof that a key was pending, a response was consumed, or the task was non-terminal.
